note: Grand Forks County Water Resources District recreation area and RV park on the Fordville Dam reservoir (Middle South Branch of the Forest River), 2 mi S, 1 mi E and 1 mi S of Fordville; boat and fishing docks, swimming beach, picnic shelters and playground. The RV loops sit in open ground back from the wooded reservoir. --Claude
